```{r}
#compute averages of pre-calculated module scores over genesets, clusters and donors
donor_clus_avg_scores <- scores_fibrosis %>%  mutate(
            Cluster= as_factor(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$Cluster),
            donor=as_factor(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$patient)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("score_fibrosis"),names_to = "Geneset", values_to = "Score") %>% 
  group_by(Cluster,donor, Geneset) %>% summarise(Score=mean(Score))%>% 
  mutate(Cluster= factor(Cluster, levels=cluster_names),
         Geneset=str_replace_all(Geneset, pattern= "_score_fibrosis", replacement = "") %>% factor())

p_avg_scores_wilcox <- wilcox_cluster_to_rest(data=donor_clus_avg_scores)

p_avg_scores_t <- t_test_cluster_to_rest(donor_clus_avg_scores)%>% arrange(p.value)

p_avg_scores_t %>% arrange(p.value)
```


```{r}
ggplot2::ggplot(
  data = donor_clus_avg_scores,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
    x    = Cluster,
    y    = Score,
    color = Cluster
  )
) +geom_jitter()+
  facet_wrap(vars(Geneset))+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90))
```


```{r}
#calculate cohnes d for each cluster average score of donors  in comparison to all other cluster-donor average scores
cohens_d_module_scores_fibrosis_donor <- tibble(geneset=character(),cluster=character(),cohens_d=numeric())
data <- donor_clus_avg_scores
for (gs in levels(data$Geneset)) {
  #print(gs)
  for (clus in levels(data$Cluster) ) { #data %>% filter(Geneset==gs) %>% pull(Cluster) %>% unique()
    #print(clus)
    ctrl <- data%>% filter(Geneset==gs, Cluster!=clus) %>% pull(Score)
    treat <- data%>% filter(Geneset==gs, Cluster==clus) %>% pull(Score)
    d <- cohen.d(treat, ctrl)
    cohens_d_module_scores_fibrosis_donor %<>%  add_row(geneset=gs,cluster=clus,cohens_d=d$estimate)
  }
}

two_highest <- donor_clus_avg_scores %>% group_by(Geneset, Cluster) %>% summarise(mean_score=mean(Score)) %>% top_n(wt=mean_score,2) %>% ungroup() %>%  mutate(rank="highest")%>% clean_names()
n_highest <- (two_highest$rank=="highest") %>% sum()

dat <- p_avg_scores_t %>% clean_names() %>% left_join(cohens_d_module_scores_fibrosis_donor,by = c("geneset", "cluster")) %>% arrange(-p_adjust) %>% left_join(two_highest,by = c("geneset", "cluster"))%>% mutate(p_adjust_highest=if_else(rank=="highest", p_value*n_highest, NULL)) %>% mutate(sig=if_else(p_adjust_highest<0.05,"sig","not sig.")) %>% arrange(p_adjust_highest) %>% mutate(cluster= factor(cluster, levels = names(color.cluster)))


dat%>% ggplot()+geom_tile(aes(x=geneset, y=cluster, fill=cohens_d)) +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 90))+scale_fill_viridis_c()+geom_point(data =(dat %>% filter(!is.na(sig))) ,aes(x=geneset, y=cluster,color=sig))+scale_color_manual(values = c("not sig"="grey", "sig"="black"))+ scale_y_discrete(names(color.cluster))
```

donor_clus_avg_scores_loo_cor <- scores_loo_corr %>%  mutate(
            Cluster= as_factor(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$Cluster),
            donor=as_factor(BAL_macrophages@meta.data$patient)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("lo_corr"),names_to = "gene_lo", values_to = "Score") 

# separate(col= gene_lo, into = c("gene_lo", "Geneset"),sep="_"#,extra = "merge" )
##this was to slow
gene_lo_slit <- donor_clus_avg_scores_loo_cor%>%  pull(gene_lo) %>% str_split_fixed(string=., pattern = "_", n=2 ) %>% as_tibble()

colnames(gene_lo_slit) <- c("gene_lo", "Geneset")
donor_clus_avg_scores_loo_cor <- donor_clus_avg_scores_loo_cor %>% 
  select(-gene_lo) %>% 
  bind_cols(gene_lo_slit)

  group_by(Cluster,donor,gene_lo, Geneset) %>% summarise(Score=mean(Score))%>% 
  mutate(Cluster= factor(Cluster, levels=cluster_names))

#   ungroup() %>%

cohens_d_lo <- donor_clus_avg_scores_loo_cor %>%
  mutate(Cluster= fct_other(Cluster,keep = "CD163LGMNM")) %>% 
  group_by(gene_lo,Geneset) %>% 
  summarise(cohens=(cohen.d(Score[Cluster=="CD163LGMNM"],Score[Cluster!="CD163LGMNM"])$estimate), mean_dif=mean(Score[Cluster=="CD163LGMNM"])-mean(Score[Cluster!="CD163LGMNM"]) ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(rank_conhens=rank(cohens), rank_meandiff=rank(mean_dif)) #%>% mutate(gene=str_remove_all(Geneset, "_Reyf_MCluster1_lo_corr") )
